tenantCopy: Minimal tenant entry for the mobile-first flow. Final onboarding, dashboard, and sharing screens land in Wave4.
tenantLoginTitle: Find housing in Korea with trust first.
tenantLoginCopy: Prepare a housing trust pass through a safe mock login that never calls real Toss OAuth.
tenantLoginCardCopy: Creates a safe session with only name and phone, then links a disposable test wallet address.
tenantLoginPointResident: Uses only the minimum foreign-resident context needed
tenantLoginPointHousing: Organizes trust context for the moment you look for housing
tenantLoginPointTrust: Prepares explainable trust that a landlord can understand
tenantLoginSafetyNote: No official Toss logo or real OAuth connection
tenantLoginErrorCopy: Check the local mini API connection, then try again.
tenantOnboardingStepResidentCopy: Instead of raw passport or sensitive records, the trust pass keeps only the minimum signals needed for housing checks.
tenantOnboardingStepHousingTitle: Explain readiness while finding a home
tenantOnboardingStepHousingCopy: Visa, work, and rent-burden context are prepared in language landlords can quickly understand.
tenantOnboardingStepTrustCopy: The flow continues toward explainable badges and a shareable report, not black-box scoring.
tenantHomeSubtitle: Prepare a first trust pass with only the details a landlord needs to understand.
tenantHomeSubtitleWithName: {name}, prepare a first trust pass with only the details a landlord needs.
tenantHomePlaceholderCopy: No trust pass has been issued yet, so this home shows a safe starting state.
tenantHomeEmptyCopy: Start by collecting visa, housing-plan, and rent-readiness context into one explainable pass.
tenantHomeToast: The trust pass creation flow will connect in the next task.
tenantWizardSubtitle: Review the flow safely with pre-submitted Testnet records and a dry-run report.
tenantWizardFixtureHappyCopy: Uses the valid visa fixture and keeps the normal trust-pass path unchanged.
tenantWizardFixtureEdgeCopy: Uses the expired E-9 visa fixture to prove credential issuance stops safely.
tenantWizardFixtureLockedNote: Fixture choice is locked after the wizard starts so retry uses the same evidence.
tenantWizardStepDidCopy: Connect Mina P.'s housing trust profile to a validated XRPL Testnet DIDSet record.
tenantWizardStepCredentialCopy: Review the visa and rent-reputation Credential issue and accept records together.
tenantWizardStepEscrowCopy: Confirm the reservation EscrowCreate record and the dry-run report badges.
tenantWizardErrorCopy: Check the local API or fixture state, then try again.
tenantWizardCredentialExpiredCopy: Visa verification failed because the E-9 visa fixture expired on {expiresAt}. Credential issuance is stopped, so no dashboard, share link, or verification report is created. Reason: {reason}
tenantWizardCredentialGuideCopy: Update the tenant evidence first, then restart this demo with a valid fixture before creating a trust pass.
tenantWizardCredentialGuideVisa: Renew or update the visa document so the expiry date is in the future.
tenantWizardCredentialGuideEmployment: Attach matching school or employer proof if the renewed visa requires supporting context.
tenantWizardCredentialGuideRetry: Retry only after the updated fixture verifies successfully; this edge path never force-issues credentials.
tenantWizardBadgeError: The report must return exactly 6 badges.
tenantDashboardSubtitle: DID, issued VCs, Testnet evidence, and a safe share link in one privacy-preserving view.
tenantDashboardTrustGradeCopy: A local report grade combining visa, employment, rent burden, escrow, payment history, and on-chain verification.
tenantDashboardContextCopy: Shows only a public Testnet address and DID, never raw passport or phone data.
tenantDashboardVcCopy: Only public Testnet evidence that a landlord can inspect is linked here.
tenantDashboardVisaVcCopy: Summarizes {visaType} stay and {schoolOrEmployer} context as a housing-check signal.
tenantDashboardRentVcCopy: Connects rent readiness and reputation signals to the report badges.
tenantDashboardBadgesCopy: The report shares exactly six badges without raw personal records.
tenantDashboardShareCopy: The share URL uses only the reportId. It never includes seeds, keys, phone, passport, or session data.
tenantDashboardWebShareA11y: Share verification report through the device share menu
tenantDashboardSharePayloadText: Please review this NomokDon housing trust report.
tenantDashboardCopyFallback: Clipboard is unavailable. Select and copy the visible link below.
tenantDashboardShareSuccess: Report sent to the device share menu.
tenantDashboardShareFallback: This browser cannot open the share menu. Copy the visible link below.
tenantDashboardUnlockTitle: Preview the limit unlock inside Toss
tenantDashboardUnlockCopy: See a mock flow for how the trust pass could explain foreigner loan readiness.
tenantDashboardUnlockCtaA11y: Open the Toss app-in-app mock unlock screen
tenantTossUnlockSubtitle: Safely demos the benefit moment without connecting to official Toss services.
tenantTossUnlockLimitCopy: {name}'s visa, rent reputation, and escrow signals are summarized as a limit-up readiness signal.
tenantTossUnlockProofCopy: This is not real loan review or credit inquiry. It is a mock experience showing how the NomokDon report becomes explainable trust signals.
tenantTossUnlockSafetyCopy: No Toss OAuth, Toss Bank loan, KYC, credit-check, or external financial API is called. No official logo or trademark image is used.
tenantTossUnlockBackA11y: Return to the trust pass dashboard
verifyCopy: Minimal verification entry for report links such as /verify/:id. Final validation states land in Wave4.
verifyResultTitle: Automatically verify the public trust report
verifyResultCopy: The page uses only the reportId in the URL, then shows badges and Testnet evidence without exposing sensitive tenant data.
verifyMissingReportCopy: Open a shared link in the /verify/report_... format.
verifyReportNotFoundCopy: The share link may be expired, or the local API has no report for this id.
verifyInvalidResponse: The report response format is invalid.
verifyInvalidBadgeCount: A verification report must include exactly 6 badges.
verifyTrustGradeCopy: A public grade combining visa, employment or school, rent burden, escrow, rent history, and on-chain verification.
verifyTenantCopy: Sensitive identity records and raw session data are never shown; landlords see only the report id and a shortened holder id.
verifyBadgesCopy: Only summaries and evidence statements needed for landlord review are public.
verifyEvidenceCopy: If the report response has no public link list, this page uses the demo fixture Testnet transactions.
verifyActionsCopy: Record only that this report was reviewed, then save as PDF from the browser print dialog if needed.
verifyActionsPrivacyCopy: No landlord name, contact details, device data, or personal information is requested or stored.
verifyConfirmSuccessCopy: Only the report ID and confirmation status were safely recorded.
verifyConfirmErrorCopy: Check the local API connection, then try again.
issuerCopy: Minimal ops console entry for protected issuance workflows. Password gate and logs land in later tasks.
issuerGateCopy: Operations stay as a placeholder for now, while access is limited by a server password and an HttpOnly session cookie.
issuerGateCardCopy: The password is never stored in the browser and is checked only by the local API.
issuerGateSafetyNote: No password storage · cookie session only
issuerGateErrorCopy: The password is incorrect. Check it and try again.
issuerGateNetworkError: Check the local API connection, then try again.
issuerGateSessionError: Session check failed. Unlock again with the password.
issuerGateConfigError: The issuer console password is not configured on the server.
issuerShellCopy: Inside the verified session cookie boundary, the console shows recent API events and public Testnet evidence only.
issuerShellPlaceholder: Operational logs, simulator, and stats screens will attach inside this protected area in later tasks.
issuerStatsCopy: Cards are computed from safe logs only, grouping simulator fixture steps as one issuance run and using explicit Escrow metadata when present.
issuerStatsTotalIssuanceCopy: One report issuance or one simulator fixture run counts once.
issuerStatsActivePassCopy: Issuance groups without failed/error status in the recent safe log window.
issuerStatsLockedEscrowCopy: Uses safe Escrow amount metadata; legacy simulator EscrowCreate falls back to the 10 XRP fixture value.
issuerStatsChartCopy: Recent safe log events bucketed by hour, rendered as inline SVG without chart libraries.
issuerStatsChartA11y: Line chart showing recent issuer log activity by hour.
issuerStatsSourceNote: Numbers are explainable fixture/log statistics, not a live custody balance or secret-backed XRPL submission.
issuerSimulatorCopy: Select only a tenant fixture to inject four public Testnet evidence steps at once: DIDSet, visa Credential, rent Credential, and EscrowCreate.
issuerSimulatorFixtureHappyCopy: Pass-path tenant for the live demo. Visa, enrollment, and rent-ledger signals connect as normal evidence.
issuerSimulatorFixtureEdgeCopy: Boundary-path tenant with expired/unverified signals, still using only the same public evidence and no key input.
issuerSimulatorNoSecretNote: No arbitrary input · no issuer key/seed exposure · public fixture-backed Testnet evidence only
issuerSimulatorResultCopy: Added {count} public Testnet evidence steps to the logs at {time}.
issuerSimulatorErrorCopy: Check the local API connection or protected session, then try again.
issuerSimulatorSessionError: The issuer session expired. Unlock the console with the password again.
issuerSimulatorFixtureError: The tenant fixture is not in the predefined allowlist.
issuerLogsActivityCopy: Only safe server fields are rendered: time, user/report context, event type, identifier, and status.
issuerLogsErrorCopy: Check the local API connection. The protected console will retry only inside the password session.
issuerLogsEmptyCopy: Toss mock login, issuer dry-runs, and landlord confirmations will appear here as they happen.
issuerTxEvidenceLiveTitle: Public XRPL Testnet transactions from logs
issuerTxEvidenceFixtureCopy: When live logs do not include transaction hashes, the console shows the pre-submitted public Testnet fixture transactions as validated evidence.
issuerTxEvidenceLiveCopy: Transaction hashes found in live logs are shown with XRPL Testnet links.
